## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes; limitations are recorded
- [ ] Schema impact and compatibility checked; generated contracts updated
- [ ] Family authorization, consent, retention and deletion reviewed
- [ ] Keyboard access, screen readers, RTL and reduced motion checked

- [ ] Relevant reviewer agents ran; findings resolved or recorded
- [ ] No secrets, family content, trackers or AI-generated executable lessons
